## About Me

I am a PhD candidate at Monash University, Department of Econometrics and Business Statistics. My research interests fall in financial econometrics, Bayesian statistics, time series forecasting and empirical finance. The project that I am working on involves state space models, Bayesian nonparametric methods and applications on the financial market. I'm currently on the 2025/26 job market.
